title: My week at summer camp
instructions: Lily yaz kampındaki haftasını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; günler, etkinlikler ve sevmediği şeyleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: Last week, I was at a summer camp near a big lake.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: There were forty children and eight teachers.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: I slept in a tent with three other girls. It was fun, but at night it was cold.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: On Monday and Tuesday, we went swimming and sailing on the lake.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: On Wednesday, it rained all day, so we made things with wood and paper.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: On Thursday, we walked up a mountain. It took four hours! My legs were very tired.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: On the last night, we had a party with music and a big fire.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: The food wasn't very good. We had pasta every day!

script.speaker: lily
script.text: But I made a lot of new friends, and I want to go again next year.
